name: Vande Devam Umapatim
text:
वन्दे देवमुमापतिं सुरगुरुं वन्दे जगत्कारणं
वन्दे पन्नगभूषणं मृगधरं वन्दे पशूनां पतिम् ॥
meaning: I bow to Lord Shiva, the husband of Uma (Parvati), the teacher of the gods, the cause of the universe, adorned with serpents, carrying a deer, and the protector of all creatures.
purpose: A verse of salutation, each line beginning “I bow”.
when: At the opening of a Shiva practice.
note: The client list gives these first two lines of a longer verse.
